flow.text: Pizzalator — Android · dark · 390×844 · tap Play on any frame

n7.text: Routine editor: preset chips, per-step kind toggle (rest auto / hands-on tap), ± minutes, remove slides out, add step, save as named preset, reset to default. PRD §4.7 presets, FR11.

n8.text: Settings › Flours: my flours + presets, add by hand, or scan a bag. Scan sheet: viewfinder with laser sweep (2.6 s demo), then protein/fibre rows highlight and fields fill green. On-device ML Kit OCR, no cloud. Wholegrain auto from fibre. PRD §4.8, FR12.

n6.text: Dough routine: chained timers for mix → rest 30 → fold → rest 15 → fold → rest 15 → knead 10 → rest 30 → ball → bulk 4 h → divide. Rests auto-run and breathe; hands-on steps wait for a tap. Preview runs 60× (Tweaks › demoSpeed). PRD §4.7.

n1.text: Calculator: style chips, flour-first or pizzas-first, flour preset + wholemeal share, oven. Numbers tween, hydration bar eases, oven tip slides in. Suggest-only tips per PRD §4.4.

n2.text: Fermentation: stage timeline (+/- hours, temp), leavening type, preferment. Yeast grams animate; timeline bar grows with total hours.

n3.text: Recipe: preferment + final dough tables, schedule with live progress, bake card for steel. Copy-as-text.

n4.text: Bake log: entries with rating + outcome chips + photo. Calibration hint card with one-tap apply (PRD §5).

n5.text: Log a bake: star rating, structured outcomes (segmented), actuals, photo, notes. Stars bounce on tap.
